summary.en: Switch game installer and manager for the Animal Crossing: New Horizons in-game agent.
summary.zh: 带通用游戏安装器的《集合啦!动物森友会》游戏内增强 Mod(agent)管理工具。

details.en: Installs NSP, NSZ, XCI and XCZ packages from the SD card, an HTTP address or a phone/computer browser; no game content is hosted by this app. Installs the Animal Crossing: New Horizons 3.0.3 agent automatically after a supported game or update, with SHA-256 verification for every agent file.
details.zh: 可从 SD 卡、HTTP 地址或手机/电脑浏览器安装 NSP、NSZ、XCI、XCZ；本应用不托管任何游戏内容。安装受支持的《集合啦!动物森友会》本体或更新后会自动安装 3.0.3 agent，agent 文件逐项 SHA-256 校验。

changelog.en:
2.0.0 - general game installer for NSP/NSZ/XCI/XCZ; local card, HTTP download and browser upload sources; resumable transfers, storage selection, game metadata and cover display, a mirrored browser UI, HOME Menu shortcut management, focus-only Home navigation and clearer diagnostics.
1.0.2 - corrected unsupported-version detection for base-only installs and improved Details diagnostics.
1.0.0 - first public agent installer with verified install/uninstall and signed update checks.
changelog.zh:
2.0.0 - 通用游戏安装器支持 NSP/NSZ/XCI/XCZ，可从 SD 卡、HTTP 下载或浏览器上传安装；加入断点续传、安装空间选择、游戏信息与封面、浏览器镜像界面、桌面快捷方式管理、首页纯焦点操作和更清晰的诊断文案。
1.0.2 - 修正只装基础版时的版本不支持判定，并改进详情页诊断。
1.0.0 - 首个公开的 agent 安装器，支持逐文件校验、安装/卸载与签名更新检查。
